title: DC-area forecast: A few evening showers possible. Saturday looks nicer than Sunday.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: A few isolated showers remain possible into this evening as temperatures drop back into the 70s. Lows tonight in the upper 60s to low 70s.

What’s next? Saturday's somewhat lower humidity and decent sunshine make it the better of the two weekend days. Scattered showers look like a good bet Sunday with a few storms possible.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Mostly cloudy this evening as a few isolated showers remain possible. Partly cloudy overnight with lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Saturday): Skies turn at least partly sunny with highs in the mid-80s. Humidity should come down a bit from today, in the moderate range with dew points in the mid-60s. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Mostly cloudy with lows bottoming out within a few degrees of 70. The chance of showers, maybe even a thunderstorm, starts to rise after midnight and especially in the predawn hours. Confidence: Medium

Sunday: Partly to mostly cloudy with highs in the low to mid-80s. Humidity is much higher with muggy dew points in the low to mid-70s. Looks like a pretty good chance of scattered showers at times during the day. A few thunderstorms are possible as well, especially mid-afternoon onward. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

Sunday night: Some showers and storms may continue just past midnight. Otherwise, skies are mostly cloudy. Muggy lows near 70 to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium

A chance of a few showers or storms may persist into Monday. Highs aim for the mid-80s to around 90 and still on the humid side. Thunderstorms, if any, shouldn't pop until the mid- to late afternoon. Confidence: Medium

Looking sunnier Tuesday as highs may again aim for the mid-80s to near 90. It should be a little less humid with lower rain chances as it looks now. Confidence: Medium

Today’s daily digit — 5/10: Cloudier and mid-80s for highs, though a bit humid. We'll see how thunderstorms progress toward our area during the afternoon.  | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

DC weather history for August 14

Relentless heat in 1980 extended a record 21-day streak of 90-degree highs, part of one of the hottest summers on record.
